name: OpenDota
tagline: Free open-source Dota 2 match, hero, and player analytics API
description: Open-source API providing Dota 2 match data, player statistics, hero analytics, rankings, and pro scene data. Offers generous free access with optional API key for higher rate limits. Community-driven project with comprehensive endpoints for match history, live games, and performance metrics.

auth.details: Optional API key via api_key query parameter for higher rate limits. Self-serve signup at opendota.com/api-keys. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute free without key; 1200 requests/day with free API key
pricing.paid_plans: Premium plans available for higher limits

rate_limits: 60 req/min unauthenticated; higher with free API key (1200/day); paid tiers for more
use_cases: get recent matches for a Dota 2 player by account ID
fetch hero statistics and win rates
look up pro player rankings and team data
get detailed match analysis including item builds and gold graphs
